statement: Classic format 0x02 uses nine decoded extension bytes from 0xA40008, increasing both stick axes to 10-bit and analog trigger readings to 8-bit, while retaining active-low button and trigger-click indications.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew pinned community documentation; no authenticated retail capture
applicability.scope: Classic Controller > Data Format 0x02. Source-only, not a physical acceptance result. Corroborates selector record; payload is larger than format 0x01.
